stations.title: Search box
stations.text: Customers type what they look for.

stations.title: Your code
stations.gap: Text becomes part of the query

captions: At Larkspur Letterpress, Deshawn finds a search that answered with every order.
The text a customer typed changed the query, so other people's orders came back.
You catch the leak, keep the text out of the query and write its test, in three tasks.
Now every search finds only the customer's own orders, whatever they type.
Same search box, same table. Text is only ever searched for.
